_comment: Root Lisa BDD behavior contract. The existing Expo gate and matrix implementations are invoked in place through package.json; they are not copied here.

mappings.evidence: renders all recorded starter entries from the served project configuration
shows an empty starter state without inventing template origins
every-section-live-or-empty
no-sourceless-row-renders-live (including before hydration)
empty-source-no-demo-fallback
direct-file-open-still-renders-demo
guard-fails-on-sourceless-row
acme live negative control
malformed live control shapes and partial composites render unknown
unknown renderer fails closed before exposing its control
preserved Quality jobs rejects an added sourceless row
callout provenance has a browser bite and sourced control
Save writes only three changed keys, rehydrates, and Discard uses the latest saved values
text, select, toggle and environment changes preserve their types and local routing
Save prevents overlapping edits and refuses an unconfirmed response
editing a legacy environment string preserves its production value
a late status render preserves the draft ${JSON.stringify(draft)} before blur
removing one duplicate tag preserves the remaining visible values
a real read-only file refusal preserves pending edits and never reports success
reports a PR, nothing to do, and a real failure without generic success
